response.original_title: The Most Haunted Theatre in America
response.overview: Award-winning filmmaker Glenn Payne takes you inside the haunted Lyric Theatre with a team of paranormal investigators and psychic mediums to explore the theatre's tragic past as a temporary hospital and morgue, following the aftermath of Tupelo's devastating 1936 tornado, which demolished most of city. Hundreds of bodies were stored under the same stage.
